title: Dementia Awareness Talk: Understanding Dementia, Supporting Those We Love
description: A Dementia Awareness Talk under the Santunan Emas Initiative. Participants learn to recognise the signs and changes of dementia, gain insight into what a person living with dementia may experience, and learn practical ways to offer support with empathy and care. The session is aimed at caregivers, family members, next-of-kin and anyone caring for an elderly loved one. Light refreshments are provided.

sources.caption:
When someone we love begins to change, understanding can make all the difference. 💛

Join us for our Dementia Awareness Talk as part of the Santunan Emas Initiative, where we learn to better recognise the signs of dementia, understand what a person living with dementia may experience, and discover practical ways to provide support with patience, empathy and compassion.

This session is especially beneficial for caregivers, family members, next-of-kin, and anyone caring for an elderly loved one.
